prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there’s no single “best” — the right AI video ad maker depends on your goal (spokesperson vs. templated social clip), budget, volume, and platform. Here are the top options and when to pick each, plus how to evaluate them.

Top choices (as of mid‑2024)
- Synthesia
  - Best for: realistic AI spokespersons / brand videos with on‑camera presenters.
  - Pros: high‑quality avatars, many languages, brand kit and enterprise controls.
  - Cons: pricier, less fine‑grained scene animation.
- HeyGen / Movio
  - Best for: affordable, realistic presenter videos and quick localized versions.
  - Pros: good multilingual support and fast turnaround.
  - Cons: can be similar to Synthesia in limits on complex motion.
- Promo.com (and Shakr)
  - Best for: high-volume social/video ads with templates for Facebook, Instagram, TikTok.
  - Pros: huge template & clip libraries, ad optimized formats, easy workflow.
  - Cons: fewer advanced AI avatar features.
- InVideo
  - Best for: small businesses and marketers who want flexible editing + templates.
  - Pros: affordable, many templates, text-to-video features.
  - Cons: voice/AI quality varies vs. avatar specialists.
- Pictory / Lumen5
  - Best for: turning blog posts, long videos, or scripts into short ad clips and repurposing content.
  - Pros: automated summarization, captioning, quick edits.
  - Cons: less control for complex animations or bespoke creative.
- VEED / Descript
  - Best for: fine editing and post‑production with strong AI tools (subtitles, overdub, filler removal).
  - Pros: text‑based editing, excellent for polishing ad edits.
  - Cons: not focused on template-driven ad creation at scale.

How to choose (quick checklist)
- Format & platform: need 9:16 for Reels/TikTok vs 16:9 for YouTube? Pick a tool with easy aspect‑ratio templates.
- Creative type: want a talking head (Synthesia/HeyGen) vs. montage ad with stock clips (Promo/InVideo)?
- Volume: creating many variants? Look for platforms with bulk/video templating and API.
- Localization: need many languages/dubbed versions? Prioritize Synthesia/HeyGen.
- Budget: Promo/InVideo/Pictory tend to be more affordable; Synthesia and enterprise tools cost more.
- Rights & stock: confirm licensing for ads and paid stock footage.
- Testing: can you A/B test different versions and track performance via integrations?

Practical next steps
- Try free trials of 2–3 finalists and produce a 15–30s ad in each.
- Export in the exact aspect ratio and upload to your target platform to validate look and captions.
- Run small A/B tests (different CTAs, thumbnails, lengths) and measure CPA/CTR.

If you tell me:
- platform(s) (Facebook/IG/TikTok/YouTube),
- ad length and style (talking head, testimonial, montage),
- budget (free/low/enterprise),
I can recommend 2–3 specific tools and a sample workflow tailored to your needs.
